{{Quote|I need you to meet with an Ithorian scientist named T'licl Zanedi. He works at an Imperial warehouse, but it ain't really a warehouse. They have some sort of scientific research going on there.|[[Qual'do Herm]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TIS" />}}
'''T'licl Zanedi''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and provided information about an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientific project to the Rebellion.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Empire is experimenting with some sort of concentrated energy compound. It's unstable and dangerous. I need you to recover a sample of that compound as well as development notes and the original design overview. I would get them, but I lack the security clearance and don't have your military prowess. Or at the very least, don't have your courage.|T'licl Zanedi, to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TIS" />}}
[[File:TliclZanediImperialWarehouse-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|T'licl Zanedi near the [[Imperial warehouse (Riverlands)|Imperial warehouse]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], T'licl Zanedi worked as a scientist for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a secret [[Imperial warehouse (Riverlands)|research center]] disguised as a simple warehouse, in the [[Riverlands]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The Imperial scientists working there intended to develop a new sort of concentrated energy source.<ref name="SWG:TIS" />

However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> T'licl Zanedi realized that the compound was unstable and dangerous. Out of concern for the possible environmental impact and long-term dangers of the Empire having such a substance, Zanedi sought out the Rebellion since he felt that he did not possess the means to do anything himself. He therefore contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In response, [[Qual'do Herm]], an Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officer]] working in the [[Hidden Rebel Base|Rebel base]] on Corellia, dispatched a group of Rebel operatives to met with T'licl near the warehouse. The Ithorian hoped that they could infiltrate the facility and gave instructions to retrieve the design overview and research notes relating to the compound, as well as a sample. The warehouse was protected by an experienced [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squad and the operation proved to be a challenge. Finally, the Rebel spacers were successful, with details of the compound eventually being turned over to Qual'do Herm and the rest of the Alliance for further investigation.<ref name="SWG:TIS" />

==Behind the scenes==
T'licl Zanedi appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TIS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> T'licl Zanedi was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]]," released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
